pr_body:
Sometimes this test stops after exactly 1000 election attempts, in which
case we never report the 1000th failure. Fixed by asserting that we do
see a report about the 990th instead.

Closes #98772

review_comments: Is the 1000 attempts some other variable/configuration?
I see thanks! In that case shouldn't we verify 999 instead of 990?

No, because we only report every 10th attempt:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/95a215e5e0d5127ae102f247c55718f7f20cc6ee/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/coordination/ElectionSchedulerFactory.java#L194
